summary: Replication catch-up coalesces repeated mission-run part rebuilds across projection chunks, then rebuilds one dirty part per writer transaction before completing projection. Scheduling skips pending runs; work, cancellation, revision, retry, attention, queue, lane and routing writers drain affected pending work before deciding. Read-only views may retain the previously projected tree during catch-up.

replay.detail: No upgrade replay. Normal replay atomically clears pending rebuild markers and emits completion observations to wake skipped decision readers.

schema.detail: No table or wire-schema change. Durable pending aggregate markers use projection-run-rebuild: keys in the existing meta table.

rules.detail: Admission, authentication, checkpoint and retention semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. Pending projection work remains recoverable after an interrupted receive or restart.

downtime.detail: No upgrade downtime. A single large run-part rebuild still occupies one writer transaction.

recovery.detail: Pending markers commit with skipped projection work and are deleted atomically with successful rebuilds. Complete projection before reverting to a build that does not understand these markers.
